Trade window: position size, orders, smart money, odds and the trade log

On a stock\'s detail, tap the chart (or the bar under it) to open a new window: the large chart, the targets for all three horizons, the full trade plan, and these tools. Position size: enter your capital, the risk per trade (0.5–2%) and delivery or intraday; the app tells you how many shares, what it costs, the loss at the stop and the gain at each target (delivery: at most 25% of the capital in one stock; intraday: margin ≈5×). Order ticket: the entry (a stop-limit for a breakout), stop and target orders; copy or share them into Kite, Angel One or Groww yourself, the app never sends an order. Smart money: open fair value gaps and order blocks from the last 6 months of daily candles, the support below and the resistance above, also on the chart. Odds: 10,000 made-up paths from this stock\'s own daily moves, and how many reach the target before the stop. Tap \"I took this trade\" to add it to the Trade log (Menu): the risk guard first checks the day\'s trade limit (3 by default), the daily loss limit (2% of capital by default) and no intraday entry after 14:45; an open intraday trade brings a square-off reminder at 15:10. In the Trade log, tap a trade to enter its exit price; the profit or loss is worked out for you.
Long term: moat checklist, quality filter, events and portfolio

Each stock\'s detail has a \"long-term checklist\" under R/S: ROCE, debt, interest cover, cash behind profit, steady profits, margin, the promoters\' stake, their selling, pledge and an auditor resigning, each ✓, ✗ or – (no figure); tap to open. In Filters, turn on \"long-term quality companies only\" to keep companies with ROCE of 15% or more, debt-to-equity of 0.5 or less, promoters at 50% or more and no pledge. The News tab starts with \"coming events\": dates of results board meetings, dividend record dates, AGMs, bonuses, splits and buybacks from the company\'s own filings. In the Watchlist\'s ≡, \"split a portfolio\" spreads an amount over the watchlist, more to the calmer stocks, with each one\'s shares and short-term or long-term tax from the day it was added. R/S history and key figures now open and close on a tap.
